general_information.name: UH, I THINK IT’S JAMAL WHITFIELD — THAT’S THE NAME I GO BY, ANYWAY, ON MY DOCUMENTS.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been… a bit hard to explain, honestly. For maybe eight months now I’ve had this growing feeling that the neighbours are watching me and talking about me, and sometimes I hear my name being called when nobody’s there. I keep thinking, maybe it’s real, maybe it isn’t — I’m not fully sure. I ended up withdrawing from my college course too, which has been a mess, and I just want to figure out what’s happening and get back to it.
current_concerns.goals: Uh, sorry, what do you mean exactly — like what I want help with, or, I don’t know, what I’m supposed to get from this? I’m kind of trying to work that out myself.
